High Court Of Judicature Of Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. C. K. Shinde, Advocate for Applicants.
Mr. G. O. Wattamwar, Agp for the State.

Coram : Kishore C. Sant, J.
Date : 6th November, 2025.

Per Court :
Usha Bhagwan Sadafale. vs State Government Of Maharashtra ... on 6 November, 2025

Learned Advocate for Applicants informs to the Court that Slp is pending in the
Supreme Court involving question of power of Court to condone delay of more than
60 days caused in filing appeal under Right to Fair Compensation And Transparency
in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation And Transparency
in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. In the present case delay is of 192 days.

He further informs that said SLP is kept on 11.11.2025.
3.
In view of the same, stand over to 03.12.2025.
( KISHORE C. SANT) Judge dyb Usha Bhagwan Sadafale.
